githubEnv.where: android-release.yml: release-android: Resolve Google Play track

githubEnv.run:
set -euo pipefail

case "${RELEASE_TRACK}" in
  internal)
    build_api_base="https://api-staging.useorbit.org"
    build_app_variant="staging"
    deployment_environment="staging"
    build_posthog_key="${STAGING_POSTHOG_KEY}"
    ;;
  open|production)
    build_api_base="https://api.useorbit.org"
    build_app_variant="production"
    deployment_environment="production"
    build_posthog_key="${PRODUCTION_POSTHOG_KEY}"
    ;;
  *)
    echo "::error::Unknown release track: ${RELEASE_TRACK}"
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

play_package_name=$(ORBIT_APP_VARIANT="${build_app_variant}" node -p "require('./apps/mobile/app.config.js')().android.package")

{
  echo "BUILD_API_BASE=${build_api_base}"
  echo "ORBIT_APP_VARIANT=${build_app_variant}"
  echo "PLAY_PACKAGE_NAME=${play_package_name}"
  echo "BUILD_POSTHOG_KEY=${build_posthog_key}"
  echo "DEPLOYMENT_ENVIRONMENT=${deployment_environment}"
  echo "BUILD_EAS_PROFILE=production"
} >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
echo "Build target: ${deployment_environment} (api_base=${build_api_base})"
echo "Play package: ${play_package_name}"
echo "| API base | \`${build_api_base}\` |" >> "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"
githubEnv.where: android-release.yml: release-android: Resolve build target

githubEnv.run:
set -euo pipefail

# A package mirror outage must not fail the release, so the build runs without ccache.
if sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq ccache; then
  ccache --set-config=max_size=2G
  ccache --set-config=compiler_check=content
  ccache --zero-stats
  ccache --show-config | grep -E "max_size|compiler_check"
  {
    echo "CCACHE_AVAILABLE=true"
    echo "CMAKE_C_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=ccache"
    echo "CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=ccache"
  } >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
else
  echo "::warning::ccache could not be installed, so the native C++ build runs without the compiler cache."
fi

githubEnv.run:
set -euo pipefail
for key in MACOS_PROVISIONING_PROFILE_BASE64 APP_STORE_CONNECT_API_PRIVATE_KEY ORBIT_APPLE_TEAM_ID; do
  if [ -z "${!key}" ]; then echo "::error::Missing $key"; exit 1; fi
done
config=apps/desktop/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json
if [ "$DESKTOP_VARIANT" = production ]; then config=apps/desktop/src-tauri/tauri.production.conf.json; fi
identifier=$(node -p 'require(process.argv[1]).identifier' "$PWD/$config")
signing="$RUNNER_TEMP/macos-signing"
mkdir -p "$signing"
(
  umask 077
  printf '%s' "$MACOS_PROVISIONING_PROFILE_BASE64" | base64 --decode > "$signing/embedded.provisionprofile"
  printf '%s\n' "$APP_STORE_CONNECT_API_PRIVATE_KEY" > "$signing/AuthKey.p8"
)
security cms -D -i "$signing/embedded.provisionprofile" > "$signing/profile.plist"
profile_application=$(/usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c 'Print :Entitlements:com.apple.application-identifier' "$signing/profile.plist")
if [ "$profile_application" != "$ORBIT_APPLE_TEAM_ID.$identifier" ]; then
  echo "::error::The provisioning profile names $profile_application, not $ORBIT_APPLE_TEAM_ID.$identifier"
  exit 1
fi
node -e 'process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({ bundle: { macOS: { files: { "embedded.provisionprofile": process.argv[1] } } } }))' \
  "$signing/embedded.provisionprofile" > "$signing/signing-config.json"
echo "ORBIT_MACOS_SIGNING=$signing" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
